title: Smart Folders
subtitle: Create folders that automatically organize your assets based on tags
emptyBody: Get started by creating your first smart folder.
confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this smart folder?

form.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional description for this smart folder
form.tagsInputPlaceholder: Type tag(s) separated by commas, then press Enter
form.tagsHelperAny: Add one or more tags (comma-separated). Assets matching ANY of these tags will appear in this folder.
form.tagsHelperAll: Add one or more tags (comma-separated). Assets matching ALL of these tags will appear in this folder.
form.noTagsBody: Add at least one tag to filter assets.
form.matchAnyLabel: ANY - Asset has at least one of the selected tags
form.matchAllLabel: ALL - Asset must have all selected tags
form.shareUsersHint: Hold Cmd/Ctrl to select multiple users
form.folderColorHint: Choose a color for the folder icon in the sidebar
form.sortOrderHint: Lower numbers appear first in the sidebar
